app_fee.value: There is no application fee for PhD (postgraduate research) applications; the GBP 75 fee is for taught courses.
app_fee.quote: There is no application fee for postgraduate research applications or Postgraduate Awards (PGAs).

fee_waiver.value: There is no PhD application fee to waive.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no application fee for postgraduate research applications or Postgraduate Awards (PGAs).

gre_general.value: The graduate school's admissions and English pages checked do not mention the GRE.

toefl_min.value: Band A, the lowest course band, needs a TOEFL iBT total of 4.5 with at least 4.5 in each part for tests taken from 21 January 2026. Band B needs 5.0 and Band C 5.5, so check the course band.
toefl_min.quote: Total Score 4.5 including minimum of 4.5 in each component

also.quote: Total Score 5.0 including minimum of 4.5 in each component

ielts_min.value: Band A, the lowest course band, needs IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no part below 6.0. Band B needs 7.0, Band C 7.5 and Band D 8.0, so check the course band.
ielts_min.quote: Overall IELTS (Academic, UKVI or Online) score of 6.5 and minimum component scores not below 6.0.

english_waiver.value: The waiver covers only nationals of, or degrees taught in, a UKVI-recognised English-speaking country. India is not on the UK list of exempt countries, so Indian applicants need an accepted test.
english_waiver.quote: You have been educated entirely in English, in a UK Visa & Immigration (UKVI) recognised English speaking country, for the duration of your degree

also.quote: You do not need to prove your knowledge of English if you’re from one of the following countries or territories, or you’ve completed a qualification equivalent to a UK degree in one of them:

notes: Warwick sets its English test minimum per course band (A to D). The TOEFL and IELTS values here are the Band A minimum; programs in higher bands carry their own value. The graduate school's admissions policy and English pages do not mention a GRE.
